dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: Hmmm. It seems that this is all the Mora I have at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: Ugh. How am I supposed to live like this?

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: Hey, hey. Relax. Relax...

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: Come on now. I've done some handiwork recently and got plenty of food in return, didn't I?

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: And so what? You want us to go on living from hand to mouth like this? What are we going to do when those menial jobs stop making us Mora?

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: I'm not going to just watch that happen, unlike you!

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: *sigh* Sometimes I wonder if I'm the only one in this family who actually worries about our future here...

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: *sigh* This is so frustrating...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: Today, perhaps. Tomorrow? I'm afraid we can't be sure.

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: With a husband like mine, we're struggling to make ends meet every day.

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: I mean, I'm not demanding that he earn huge sums or anything, but I'd at least like a steady income.

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: But apart from cooking, he can't do anything at all.

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: And everyone here in Aaru Village knows how to cook their own food. It's how we survive here... So who's going to buy food off the street?

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: And even that would still be acceptable... But not only does he make no attempt to earn Mora, he gives out the food he makes to others! For free!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: See you. Let me see if I can save some Mora on our expenditures anywhere else...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about talking it out with him?

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: I've tried talking, and I've tried scolding.

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: You know, he even considered leaving the village to look for some work, but then he claimed he'd miss home... or that he was sensitive to the humidity...

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: In the end, he just can't bear to leave me here alone in the village. And what am I supposed to do about that?

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: He's a good man. He's so good, he would spend our Mora on helping others.

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: I'm not saying that helping others is bad, but we need to look out for ourselves first, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: That was a tough round... Do you think I've got what it takes to be a pro?

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: Ugh... I still need more training!
